note: Inventory created in this import: data/inventory.json did not exist in the initial tree, despite the historical change referring to schema 3. items describes available bytes of imported, revised or split representations; it excludes the inventory itself and complete reconstructed ignored files. sourceBytes/sourceSha256 describe the current source. Metadata/front matter and scientific manifests preserve their source hashes; editorial hashes are in items. Configurations are separate in configurations; only queries[].rationale differs in the catalog. generatedMetadata records guides and packaging manifests, not imported materials. Review is editorial and does not reopen scientific decisions. Every CSV part repeats the header, removed during reassembly; SQL parts are concatenated in order. gitEligible means eligible by size/format, not already added to the index; requiresForceAdd identifies files hidden by Git rules.
